faq.question: Is a Master’s in Aerospace Engineering available in Mauritius?
faq.answer: A dedicated Master’s in Aerospace Engineering is not listed in the University of Mauritius’s published 2026–2027 taught postgraduate catalogue. An online Aeronautical Engineering programme is advertised for the Mauritius market by TECH Global University, but it is important to verify the qualification’s recognition and status.

faq.question: Can I study Aerospace Engineering online?
faq.answer: Yes, TECH Global University advertises an online Master’s Degree in Aeronautical Engineering with a stated duration of 12 months. Check the full fee, award details and recognition before enrolling.

faq.question: What is the estimated cost of living in Mauritius?
faq.answer: A preliminary budget is around MUR 15,000–25,000 per month, approximately ₹30,000–₹50,000 at the illustrative exchange rate used here. Actual expenses depend on accommodation and lifestyle.

faq.question: Can Indian students apply for postgraduate Aerospace Engineering programmes abroad?
faq.answer: Indian students can apply if they meet the specific institution’s entry requirements. They should also verify the qualification’s recognition in India, especially if they plan to pursue further education or regulated aviation work.

faq.question: What career options are available after this qualification?
faq.answer: Depending on your training and experience, possible areas include aerospace design, aerodynamics, aircraft structures, propulsion, flight control and computational fluid dynamics. Check whether the programme offers the technical depth and recognised qualification required for your intended role.
